config._about: PROPOSED next card vault generation (2026-10-20, NOT deployed, founder decision pending). The numbers of r2t5.config.json (generation R2T5, run R2T5-DEPLOY-03, LIVE on mainnet since 2026-10-18) with two hardening fixes. r2t5.config.json and contracts/ stay exactly as deployed, so the run-03 scripts keep regenerating byte for byte. Deploying this file means a new generation: new seal and record tokens, a new genesis and new addresses for all eight contracts. Generate with: node r2t5-generate.mjs --config r2t5.next.config.json --out out-next

hardening._note: What differs from R2T5. (a) freeze window: R2T5 lets a seal's heartbeat be up to heartbeatSlackBlocks (72) older than the block that mines the seal, while payable-from = heartbeat + payoutDelayBlocks (144), so guardians are guaranteed only 72 blocks. Here payoutDelayBlocks is 216, so the guaranteed window is 216 - 72 = 144 (freezeWindowBlocks, checked by the generator); no template change. (b) copyFreezeSticks: in R2T5 a seal copy frozen on its own is re-created unfrozen by the next head action, because copy.kiss accepts anything when the head is input 0 and the head cannot read a copy's state. contracts-next/copy.kiss lets the head carry a frozen copy only into a freeze (port 27 stays 1), a guardian release (act 3) or a guardian succession (act 4).
hardening._payNeedsVaultNote: 2026-11-04 (the-bay-8a, on stables-f0's go for the card): payNeedsVault closes card review F8 (every paying path spends from the vault, its address sealed in port 8); proposalWithin bounds a Council proposal's effective-at to at most 432 blocks ahead (twice the payout delay), the Bridge finding of 2026-11-04.
hardening._switchesNote: Founder 2026-11-03 (stables-57): every protection in place in R2T6, so each can be relied on when the time comes: handover only to backup approver sets after a 7-day public wait (successionToBackup, backupSets 3 sets of 11 keys), the public guardian swap (guardianSwapPublic), MAST branches for the rare head acts.

chain._note: Minima aims at one block about every 50 seconds: 72 an hour, 1,728 a day. All waits below are in blocks.

council._note: As R2T5, except payoutDelayBlocks 216 (was 144) and the new freezeWindowBlocks: the least time between the block that mines a seal and its payable-from is payoutDelayBlocks - heartbeatSlackBlocks = 144. A seal mined at once pays 216 blocks (3 hours) later; one mined at the edge of the slack pays 144 blocks later.
council._sizeNote: vault-shared draft (2026-11-01): 5 seal copies, not 6, so the 7-of-11 seal with a C4 change proposal stays under 90% of the TxPoW limit (6 copies: 91%). One exit fewer per block. Stables decides.

guardians._note: Community guardians, each running the open-source checker on its own machine. Their keys sit in the seal state (ports 80 on, last check-in 100 on), so the set renews itself: a guardian checks in now and then; a seat whose guardian has not checked in for inactiveAfterBlocks goes to a candidate who proposes itself (signs), elected by more than half of the guardians active within activeWindowBlocks, and at least electMin of them.

fallback._note: The fallback pays an exit nobody acted on, but only while the Council is alive (heartbeat) and not frozen.

exitRecord._note: The chain remembers every paid card coin (sorted list in a Merkle tree, keyed by the first 16 bytes of the card coin id). Shards split the key space by its first byte: one payout per shard per block. Depth 24 = 16.7 million exits per shard, proofs of 966 bytes.

meter._note: Caps per token per period, split evenly over the shards (the record coin of each shard carries its meter).

deposits._note: R2T4 gate shape pointed at the new vault; one deposit per lane per block.

limits._note: C5: the Council limit per record shard per period. initial is sealed at genesis; changes go through a public proposal (C4) and never pass hardMax, which is fixed in the scripts. Placeholders until the DAO sets them.

act10.script: ASSERT (PREVSTATE(32) NEQ 0) AND ((@BLOCK-PREVSTATE(32)) GTE 12096) AND (STATE(32) EQ 0) LET j=PREVSTATE(33) IF (PREVSTATE(59) EQ 1) AND ((@BLOCK-PREVSTATE(100+j)) LT 103680) THEN RETURN SAMESTATE(80 88) AND SAMESTATE(100 108) ENDIF ASSERT SIGNEDBY(PREVSTATE(34)) AND (STATE(80+j) EQ PREVSTATE(34)) ASSERT (STATE(100+j) LTE @BLOCK) AND (STATE(100+j) GTE (@BLOCK-72)) LET i=0 WHILE i LT 9 DO ASSERT (j EQ i) OR (SAMESTATE(80+i 80+i) AND SAMESTATE(100+i 100+i)) LET i=i+1 ENDWHILE RETURN TRUE
